digest.component_or_area: build provenance semantics and artifact probe workflow
propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export 3,019 checkout files causing repeated redundant builds across xdist workers, while production hatch_build.py requires only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py.
Artifact-probe workflow uses GITHUB_SHA instead of final checkout HEAD and asserts truthiness rather than exact SHA equality, accepting wrong but nonempty patchset provenance.
Per-worker session fixture initialization in xdist -n 3 mode causes 6.60–6.74s setup per worker; minimal fixture reduces setup to 2.20–2.88s.

Production hook behavior (env override, git fallback, blank-env failure, sdist preservation, shallow-source) must be verified through real isolated PEP 517 boundary on minimal fixture across all OS/Python cells.
Workflow lanes must derive expected commit SHA via git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and enforce exact equality on installed wheel and sdist artifacts.
